Given the food-safety nature, flagging this loudly rather than quietly dropping it -- Joal should do one manual check of the profile to confirm before treating this as resolved. unanswered.text: great food staff was on point very friendly, I highly recommend it and definitely driving 3 hours to go back.
unanswered.draftReply: Sergio, thank you for making the trip out to see us! Our team works hard to make every visit feel like that, so hearing you're already planning the drive back means the world. See you next time!

unanswered.text: We were looking for a dog friendly restaurant on our way home to san diego. The food was great and our dog loved what you had. The waitress was great.
unanswered.draftReply: Betty, thank you so much! We love having four-legged guests on the patio, and we're so glad your pup enjoyed it as much as you did. Safe travels down to San Diego, and come see us again next time you're passing through!

unanswered.text: Wow. Horchata Latte? Yes please. Excellent service, even better Baristas. A must stop when in SB
unanswered.draftReply: Geoff, the Horchata Latte thanks you right back! Our baristas will be thrilled to hear that -- come say hi again soon.
